name: ACPBench Hard
intro: ACPBench Hard 将 ACPBench 的动作、变化与规划能力改写为开放式生成任务，并新增“下一动作”，共覆盖 13 个 PDDL 领域与 8 类任务。数据由 PDDL 问题、Top-K 规划、计划/状态采样、符号化问答和领域模板翻译构建；模型回答经任务专用语法解析器和符号规划验证器判分，而不是交给 LLM 裁判。
build_method: 13领域PDDL生成, Top-K规划与状态采样, 8类符号问答, 模板翻译
build_method_en: 13-domain PDDL generation, Top-K planning and state sampling, 8 symbolic QA tasks, template translation
intro_en: ACPBench Hard converts ACPBench's action, change, and planning capabilities into open-ended generation tasks and adds next-action prediction, covering 13 PDDL domains and eight task families. It is built from PDDL problems, Top-K plans, sampled plans/states, symbolic QA, and domain-template translation. Task-specific grammar parsers and symbolic planning validators score model answers instead of an LLM judge.
scale_en: 320 development examples; 1,040 test questions (13 domains × 8 tasks × 10)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.24378 Sections 5-7 and Appendix A.3-A.5 plus the official IBM ACPBench page. The diagram follows the paper's six-step generation workflow, distinguishes the 320-example dev set from the 1,040-question test set, includes all 13 domains and eight open-ended tasks, captures reachability-certainty skips and retained validation artifacts, and separates stored/simulated checks from planner-backed validators after two-shot temperature-0 inference and grammar parsing.
